explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.want: find Biscuit and bring him home before dark

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.want: to chase scents and then get back to Explorer

gran.want: to see both of them home safe

truth.statement: Biscuit chased a rabbit's scent, got turned around in the mist, and is sheltering in the hollow under the fallen oak, where his collar bell can be heard.
truth.question: Where did Biscuit go when he ran into the woods?

f1.text: Biscuit ran into the woods after something and Explorer must find him.

f2.text: Gran said Explorer must be home by dusk.

f3.text: A thick afternoon mist hides the paw prints Explorer is following.

f4.text: Explorer stands at a fork where many trails leave the clearing.

f5.text: Explorer finds a trail marked by a mossy stump.

f6.text: Explorer sees a half-hidden paw print by the stump.

f7.text: Explorer finds a bent fern that might mark a dog's path.

f8.text: Explorer finds a bramble gap too narrow to follow.

f9.text: Explorer hears a distant bark that echoes off the trees.

f10.text: Explorer finds a muddy track that circles back to the fork.

f12.text: Explorer reaches a stream with stepping stones.

f13.text: Explorer finds a wet paw print on a stone and a loose branch.

f14.text: Explorer crosses the stones and sees a fox-sized shape in the mist.

f15.text: Explorer follows the stream bank and finds a drift of ferns.

f16.text: Explorer finds a fallen scrap of Biscuit's blue ribbon on the bank.

f17.text: Explorer stands at a clearing where the stream trail meets another path.

f18.text: Explorer finds fresh rabbit tracks beside the stream path.

f19.text: Explorer finds a leaf pile that Biscuit has clearly dug in.

f21.text: Explorer reaches a pine grove with soft needles.

f22.text: Explorer finds a pinecone trail that fades into the needles.

f23.text: Explorer finds a squirrel's nest and a faint scratch on a trunk.

f24.text: Explorer reaches a ring of tall pines where paths cross.

f25.text: Explorer finds a hint of Biscuit's fur on a low branch.

f26.text: Explorer climbs a rocky rise above the mist.

f27.text: Explorer sees treetops and a far-off hollow from the rise.

f28.text: Explorer reaches a ledge where two ways run on.

f29.text: Explorer finds a dry creek bed crossing the path.

f30.text: Explorer finds a wide mossy path leading down.

f31.text: Explorer finds a muddy dip with one small paw print.

f32.text: Explorer finds a crooked sign that points two ways.

f34.text: Explorer reaches a meadow of tall grass wet with mist.

f35.text: Explorer finds a trampled patch where Biscuit may have rolled.

f36.text: Explorer meets an old stone bridge over a gully.

f37.text: Explorer hears a faint jingle like a collar bell near the bridge.

f38.text: Explorer checks under the bridge and finds only a duck feather.

f39.text: Explorer finds a path beyond the bridge heading toward a big oak.

f41.text: Explorer finds a berry thicket with chewed stems.

f42.text: Explorer finds berry juice on a rock that looks like a paw smudge.

f43.text: Explorer reaches a ferny dell with three exits.

f44.text: Explorer takes the left exit and finds a log with a pawprint.

f45.text: Explorer follows the log trail and finds a damp knot of leaves.

f46.text: Explorer takes the middle exit and finds a heap of old branches.

f47.text: Explorer takes the right exit and finds a rusty gate post.

f50.text: Explorer reaches the big oak clearing as the light turns gold.

f51.text: Explorer stops to rest and lets the mist drift while listening.

f52.text: Explorer hears the woods grow quiet and knows dusk is near.

f53.text: Explorer calls out Biscuit's name and waits for an answer.

t_bell.text: A faint collar bell jingles from under the fallen oak.

t_hollow.text: Biscuit is sheltering in the hollow under the fallen oak.

f57.text: Explorer decides to crawl in by the root side of the hollow.

f58.text: Explorer reaches in gently and feels Biscuit's wet nose.

f59.text: Explorer coaxes Biscuit out with a soft whistle.

f60.text: Explorer decides to call from the top of the log.

f61.text: Explorer hears Biscuit's tail thump inside the hollow.

f62.text: Explorer sees two bright eyes peek out of the hollow.

f63.text: Explorer decides to share the last biscuit from a pocket.

f64.text: Explorer holds out the treat and Biscuit sniffs it.

f65.text: Explorer sits still until Biscuit creeps out on his own.
